body_html:
About

I'm a Computer Science graduate interested in building software, working with cloud infrastructure, and understanding how systems operate from development through deployment.

My projects span native desktop applications, full-stack web applications, distributed systems, and software engineering projects.

What I Build

Software Development

Applications focused on practical problems, clean architecture, and maintainable code.

Cloud & Infrastructure

Hands-on projects involving AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Linux, and system monitoring.

Systems

Experience working with networking, parallel computing, HPC environments, and lower-level programming.

Currently

I'm currently looking for software engineering and cloud-focused roles where I can apply my development and systems experience while continuing to grow as an engineer.
